h1: Custom Short Sleeve Jackets for Teams & Events
metaTitle: Custom Short Sleeve Jackets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom short sleeve jackets for your team or event. Perfect for outdoor work, trade shows, and giveaways. Bulk discounts available.
introHtml: Short sleeve jackets offer a lighter alternative for outdoor branding when a full jacket would be too warm. Perfect for spring promotions, outdoor events, or uniform layers in mild climates, they combine the professional look of a jacket with the comfort of a shirt. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing on styles like the New Era Cage 1/4-Zip or the reversible vest. Ideal for marketing directors and safety managers seeking versatile, year-round apparel.
heroAltText: Custom short sleeve jackets with embroidered logos, including a quarter-zip and a reversible vest, displayed on models.
